metadata.mechanics: When completed, the player of the Target corpse may continue roleplay as their dead character for the next 24 hours (or until again killed). This character is banned from CvC and cannot regain Infection through any means. At the end of the 24 hours the character can never come back in any form again.
metadata.notes: The Corpse of a zombie resulting from the permanent death of a PC is a valid Target for this procedure.
metadata.validTargetDescription: One Target Corpse of a Lineage that has reached 0 Infection.
metadata.descriptionOfRoleplay: Sometimes, there is no way to save someone – no way to bring them back. However, there is a chance to say good-bye. An individual may completely dismantle a corpse while using hooch to help preserve the body and the Infection. Using needle and thread to stitch the corpse back together, they may then inject the corpse with infectious material straight to the person’s heart to jumpstart it – at least for a limited time. Beginning this Procedure pauses the timer for when the Target Corpse would sink into the Mortis.
